title: Concept: Redirect via new PageReference (apex) — review required
description: In apex, new PageReference issues a redirect to a caller-chosen address. Open targets let attackers craft trusted-looking links to hostile sites. The remedy is target validation via a fixed allowlist of page names.
applicability: apex request handlers redirecting through new PageReference; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Phishing and token theft via trusted-domain links; MEDIUM severity, HIGH when redirects carry tokens.
